newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen $0.50 higher -trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen $0.50 higher -trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Thursday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt higher, supported by projections for strong packer demand, livestock dealers said.
Cash hog prices started Wednesday weak but turned firmer amid ideas that higher pork prices at midday signaled that pork demand had improved, they said.

Support also was expected from forecasts for a spring snowstorm Thursday and Friday in the western Corn Belt. The storm could make for difficult marketings by causing slick country roads and reducing visibility, dealers said.
